slot.intent: Marcus Hale is the fund's chief auditor, the man whose signature sat on every clean report.

concept: One thin red rule is the seam and comes first: it draws out in one stroke to the block's width, the name rises from behind it and the role drops out below it.
storyboard: 0.0 s: before anything else, a thin red rule draws out from the lower left in one brisk stroke
0.25 s, on "Marcus": the first name rises out from behind the rule once its edge has passed the word, grey settling to off white
0.4 s: the rule's stroke eases to a stop at the block's full width, the width of the longer of the two lines
0.8 s, on "Hale,": the surname rises out from behind the rule the same way
1.7 s, on "the": the role starts below the rule in small widely tracked capitals, dropping out from under it, grey settling to off white
2.5 s, on "fund's": the next role word drops out the same way
3.3 s, on "chief": the third role word drops out the same way
4.2 s, on "auditor.": the last role word lands under the rule's end
4.6 s: full hold on name, rule and role to the end; the camera never moves

leansOn.why: Words drop out from under a rule whose edge paces them, the vocabulary the owner approved for this channel.
